Read the wavelength data blocks from a biotek .csv file.

Source: R/plate_biotek.R
plate_read_biotek_wl.Rd

Read the wavelength data blocks from a biotek .csv file.

Usage

plate_read_biotek_wl(file, format_well = TRUE, plate = NULL)

Arguments

file

File path to the .csv file.

format_well

Whether to format the well column of the returned dataframes.

plate

The size of the plate, such as 96 or 384, or its number of rows and columns. If NULL, the plate size recorded in the file is used, or else the smallest standard plate that holds all the wells.

Value

a tibble. The well column holds well() IDs that know the size of the plate.

Examples

file_data <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "2024-02-29_vio_GFP_main.csv",
  package = "wellr"
)

plate_read_biotek_wl(file_data)
#> # A tibble: 23,616 × 4
#>    id    wavelength well      value
#>    <chr>      <dbl> <well:96> <dbl>
#>  1 1            300 A01       0.28 
#>  2 1            300 A02       0.284
#>  3 1            300 A03       0.285
#>  4 1            300 A04       0.285
#>  5 1            300 A05       0.285
#>  6 1            300 A06       0.284
#>  7 1            300 A07       0.275
#>  8 1            300 A08       0.279
#>  9 1            300 A09       0.282
#> 10 1            300 A10       0.28 
#> # ℹ 23,606 more rows
plate_read_biotek_wl(file_data, format = FALSE)
#> # A tibble: 23,616 × 4
#>    id    wavelength well      value
#>    <chr>      <dbl> <well:96> <dbl>
#>  1 1            300 A1        0.28 
#>  2 1            300 A2        0.284
#>  3 1            300 A3        0.285
#>  4 1            300 A4        0.285
#>  5 1            300 A5        0.285
#>  6 1            300 A6        0.284
#>  7 1            300 A7        0.275
#>  8 1            300 A8        0.279
#>  9 1            300 A9        0.282
#> 10 1            300 A10       0.28 
#> # ℹ 23,606 more rows
